profile.ja: 上忍。ふうま八将が一角・二車家を支える幹部。鬼蜘蛛家は代々“獣遁の術”使いで知られ、当主となるものは「三郎」を引き継ぐ。そして１８代目三郎は少女である。幼くして類まれなる才能をみせた少女に、二車骸佐は当主の座を認めたのである。１８代目三郎の“獣遁の術”は通称“獣使い”とも呼ばれる忍法で、彼女は巨大な鬼蜘蛛を操る。自身は巨大な鬼蜘蛛の上にちょこんと座り、猛烈なスピードと牙で敵を引き裂かせ、あるいは毒で麻痺した敵の体液を生きたまま吸わせ、時に蜘蛛の糸で敵を絡め取り、一瞬で高層ビルの屋上へと飛翔する。そう、彼女と鬼蜘蛛は魔獣アラクネのように一心同体なのだ。
profile.en: She is a high-ranking ninja and a key officer supporting the Icchou and Nisha families of the Fuuma. The Onigumo family has long been known for its mastery of the "Beast Evasion Technique", with each successive head of the family inheriting the title of "Saburo". The 18th Saburo is a young girl, recognized as the family head by Nisha Gaiza due to her exceptional talent from a young age. The 18th Saburo's "Beast Evasion Technique" is also known as the "Beast Tamer" ninja art, which allows her to control a giant Onigumo spider. She sits atop the giant spider, using its incredible speed and fangs to tear enemies apart, or its venom to paralyze them and drain their bodily fluids while they're still alive. At times, she uses the spider's web to entangle her enemies, and in an instant, she can leap to the rooftop of a skyscraper. Indeed, she and the Onigumo spider are like the demon beast Arachne, a single entity with one mind.

text.ja: 十八代目鬼蜘蛛三郎。力は貸すわ、力はね……何よ、他人行儀？　本当、甘ったるいったらないわね
text.en: I'm the 18th Onigumo Saburo. I'll lend you my power, but don't get too comfortable... what's with the formalities? Honestly, it's a bit too much.

text.ja: 何かしら？　別に話しかけるなとまでは言っていないでしょう。そうやってモジモジされている方が気持ち悪いわ
text.en: What is it? I didn't say you couldn't talk to me, but standing there looking all nervous is kind of annoying.

text.ja: 次の任務の動きを教えて欲しいわ。……積極的？　くすくす、楽天家ね。ただ骸佐さまや尚兄以外からあまり指示を受けたくないだけよ
text.en: I want to know about our next mission. You think I'm being too optimistic? Ha ha, I just don't want to take orders from anyone except Nisha Gaiza or Daigoro, that's all.

text.ja: 大五郎の餌の話？　お互い必要以上には干渉しない約束でしょう。それともあなたが用意してくれるのかしら？
text.en: You want to talk about Daigoro's food? We have an agreement not to interfere with each other's business, don't we? Or are you offering to take care of it for me?

text.ja: もう子供じゃないわ……分かってるならいいの。でも、それじゃあ、今後ろに隠したアイスは何かしら？
text.en: I'm not a kid anymore... as long as you understand that, it's fine. But what's with the ice cream you're hiding behind you?

text.ja: ほら、これ。この前言っていた書物よ。いいから受け取りなさい、あなたには借りを作りたくないの。それだけよ
text.en: Look, take this. It's that book I was telling you about. Just take it, I don't want to owe you anything. That's all.

text.ja: 爺様が強かったのは認めるわ。でも見た目で比べられて見くびられるのだけは、いつ聞いても我慢ならないわね
text.en: I admit, my grandfather was strong. But I hate being compared to him just because of my appearance. It's frustrating to hear that all the time.

text.ja: 大五郎とはいつも一緒よ。おかしいかしら？　自分の四肢をつけ外しする人間がいる？　……いるわね。けど私にはそのくらい身近という事よ
text.en: Daigoro and I are always together, aren't we? Is that weird? I mean, there are people who can detach and reattach their own limbs... but to me, that's just normal.
